elements.name: intro_text
elements.html:
Welcome to CodeAI's 2026-27 Check-In Survey for Middle School content teachers

You taught CS Discoveries or other CodeAI middle school content last school year, and it looks like you haven’t yet started a CodeAI middle school course this year. We’d like to know why.

You can also be entered into a drawing for one of three $100 gift cards.

Privacy and Confidentiality

  • Your individual responses here are completely confidential.
  • Your identity will never be revealed publicly or used to tie any responses back to you personally.
  • We may share de-identified, aggregate data (representing all responses) publicly.
  • Your de-identified responses will be used by CodeAI to improve our curriculum and programs.

This survey should take less than 5 minutes to complete.  Your complete honesty and candor are appreciated.
